title: Engagement aggregates import
description: One row of a counts file the owner fills in by hand from the Meta Content Library and imports with python -m pipeline.engagement import. The header is a strict whitelist: every column listed under required must be present, views may be left out, and no other column is accepted. Every value is text as read from the CSV. Counts only: no post, no account, no link to a platform, no time finer than a day. pipeline/engagement.py reads the columns, the required list and each pattern from this file, and adds the checks a pattern cannot express (links, long digit strings, times, small cells).

key_type.description: url_hash: the counts for one state origin article; outlet_month: the counts for one outlet over one calendar month

key.description: the url_hash column of the urls file, or <outlet_id>:<YYYY-MM>

period_start.description: first day counted, a day only

period_end.description: last day counted, a day only

posts_n.description: public posts found; blank only when suppressed

reactions.description: summed over those posts; blank when suppressed or posts_n is 0

shares.description: summed over those posts; blank when suppressed or posts_n is 0

comments.description: summed over those posts; blank when suppressed or posts_n is 0

views.description: optional column; blank when the library gives no view count

suppressed.description: 1 when posts_n was between 1 and the minimum cell less one, so no count is kept

query_date.description: the day the library was queried

mcl_query_ref.description: the owner's own reference for the query, as written in data/engagement/QUERY_LOG.md
